page.notes: Top of the scan cut off: the first line and the start of several lines are clipped, so opening letters are missing and marked as fragments. Right edge and bottom are partly cut. Red initials are printed in red and are copied as plain letters; "Ecce" (line 11) and "Et" (line 24) are doubtful because the red initials are clipped or stylised. Line 28 is clipped at the bottom edge and its opening letters are doubtful. Hyphen after "dede" and "si" is a printed slanted hyphen. "tabernaculuz", "atqꝫ" and "tpibus" follow the printed forms and may be abbreviations rather than letters. Show-through at the top is not transcribed.
